nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Casa Sorveglianza card adapts tile layout to camera count
nodes.rationale: Reddit user reported the home card always showed camList[0] only. Fixed by sorting motion-first and rendering 1/2/3/4/5+ layouts (hero, side-by-side, 2-top+1-wide, 2x2, top3+more); mobile caps at 2 tiles. Justified by noting the Sorveglianza tab already fires one snapshot request per camera on the same timer, so up to 4 parallel home-card requests is not a new ceiling.
nodes.norm_label: casa sorveglianza card adapts tile layout to camera count

nodes.label: Room tiles size to content instead of stretching
nodes.rationale: Reddit user compared against Dwains Dashboard: a 1-light room and a 6-device room rendered as the same 190px tile. Fixed via grid-auto-rows:min-content on [data-r="rooms"]; rooms.max default raised 8->12 since rows no longer need a fixed height to look intentional.
nodes.norm_label: room tiles size to content instead of stretching

nodes.label: Rooms discover 7 more HA domains
nodes.rationale: Added humidifier, lock, water_heater, valve, lawn_mower, siren with per-domain busy/active semantics (e.g. lock is active when unlocked, valve when open, siren when sounding — not a plain on/off inverse).

nodes.label: Room cards show binary_sensor status pills
nodes.rationale: door/window/opening/garage_door, motion/occupancy/presence, moisture/smoke/gas pills; capped at four in priority order, only shown while 'on' since a closed door is the normal state.
nodes.norm_label: room cards show binary_sensor status pills

nodes.label: Switch shows inline instantaneous wattage from co-located power sensor
nodes.rationale: Reuses the same device->entity relationship already used for cameras and their motion sensor; voltage/current/energy sensors remain deliberately never shown.
nodes.norm_label: switch shows inline instantaneous wattage from co-located power sensor

nodes.label: Energy tab falls back to Fotovoltaico-derived data on zero-config installs
nodes.rationale: Reddit report: instant-power (kW) cells only ever come from config.energy, but energy/get_prefs and auto-discovery resolve energy (kWh) counters, not power, so a zero-config install saw an empty header despite the home screen working.
nodes.norm_label: energy tab falls back to fotovoltaico-derived data on zero-config installs

nodes.label: Trend chart shows a message instead of zero-height bars when no history exists
nodes.rationale: A flat row of zero-height bars reads as 'you produce nothing' rather than 'no data yet' — same config.energy gap as the zero-config fallback issue.
nodes.norm_label: trend chart shows a message instead of zero-height bars when no history exists

nodes.label: Root container padding increased to match neumorphic shadow reach
nodes.rationale: Padding (16px/18px) was smaller than the shadow's reach (22px), so shadows on edge-flush cards were clipped by overflow:hidden; padding raised to 22px/24px. Mobile unaffected since its page isn't clipped.
nodes.norm_label: root container padding increased to match neumorphic shadow reach

nodes.label: Compact Fotovoltaico card regains visible self-consumption/grid/feed values
nodes.rationale: The camera-present compact layout swapped the three-line legend for a one-line summary that dropped the values entirely; replaced with three small tiles under the ring.
nodes.norm_label: compact fotovoltaico card regains visible self-consumption/grid/feed values

nodes.label: Energy chart colors aligned with home-screen ring grammar
nodes.rationale: Chart had sage/terracotta reversed relative to the ring (sage=solar, terracotta=grid); fixed alongside adding the fed-to-grid bar so both views agree. Matches the project's non-negotiable sage=sun/terracotta=grid color rule.
nodes.norm_label: energy chart colors aligned with home-screen ring grammar

nodes.label: Third bar for energy fed back to the grid added to trend charts
nodes.rationale: The ring already tracked the daily feed-to-grid total but the trend chart never showed it; installs without an export sensor keep the two-bar layout.
nodes.norm_label: third bar for energy fed back to the grid added to trend charts

nodes.label: Mobile no longer renders each appliance twice
nodes.rationale: dash_neumo_mobile.html had two identical loops over the appliance list inside the room card, a copy-paste leftover the desktop layout never had.
nodes.norm_label: mobile no longer renders each appliance twice

nodes.label: Removed unreliable 'N min remaining' text for running appliances
nodes.rationale: HA integrations report remaining-time inconsistently enough (units, absolute vs relative) to render nonsense (e.g. '2026 min remaining'); shows the state label instead. The optional remaining config field, its i18n string, and the demo sensor are removed.
nodes.norm_label: removed unreliable 'n min remaining' text for running appliances

nodes.label: Support HA's flat grid-source energy schema alongside flow_from/flow_to
nodes.rationale: Home Assistant reports a grid source's import/export sensors either nested under flow_from/flow_to (handled since 1.4.1) or directly on the source (stat_energy_from at top level) — both are now read, deduped if reported both ways. Matches the project's documented energy-schema field-shape constraint.
nodes.norm_label: support ha's flat grid-source energy schema alongside flow_from/flow_to

nodes.label: Diagnostic log lists unrecognized field names on unresolved energy sources
nodes.rationale: The [live_dashboard] energia diagnostic log now lists the field names it did find on an unrecognized source shape, letting a future install self-diagnose instead of seeing just 'not found'.
nodes.norm_label: diagnostic log lists unrecognized field names on unresolved energy sources

nodes.label: src/href/points attributes set imperatively after mount, not via template holes
nodes.rationale: The browser's HTML parser fetches / the instant it parses the tag, before any app code runs, so a literal '{{ m.icon }}' placeholder was fetched as a URL and logged as a 404 within ~30ms of navigation. Fixed by never writing these attributes with template holes in raw markup; a ref callback sets them after mount once real data exists.
nodes.norm_label: src/href/points attributes set imperatively after mount, not via template holes

nodes.label: First pre-boot render resolves to nothing shown instead of a permanent 'never resolved' warning
nodes.rationale: The template runtime logged '{{ S.onNow }} never resolved' for text that was always correct on screen, because the very first synchronous render (before real data loads) briefly had no value. Also fixed a related 1.4.0 timing gap where a card and its text readiness could disagree.
nodes.norm_label: first pre-boot render resolves to nothing shown instead of a permanent 'never resolved' warning

nodes.label: Energy role mapping sums every HA Energy-dashboard entry instead of keeping only the first
nodes.rationale: energy/get_prefs auto-discovery previously kept only the first entry per role and silently dropped the rest, breaking installs with a second solar array or grid contract.
nodes.norm_label: energy role mapping sums every ha energy-dashboard entry instead of keeping only the first

nodes.label: Near-zero ring segments use stroke-linecap:butt instead of round
nodes.rationale: stroke-linecap:round still paints a dot for a zero-length dash, drawing a stray dot at the segment boundary for a near-zero feed-to-grid segment; butt draws nothing for zero length.
nodes.norm_label: near-zero ring segments use stroke-linecap:butt instead of round

nodes.label: console.info at boot names the resolution tier and value for each energy role
nodes.rationale: Names which tier resolved each role (config.js, HA Energy dashboard, or auto-discovery) plus the entity/statistic and value, distinguishing a wrong/missing number from a completely unresolved sensor. A real get_prefs failure now logs console.warn instead of being silently treated as 'no Energy dashboard configured'.
nodes.norm_label: console.info at boot names the resolution tier and value for each energy role

nodes.label: Fotovoltaico ring redesigned as two concentric rings with real totals
nodes.rationale: The old ring compared production against grid import, two numbers never meant to sum to anything. New ring: outer = house consumption (self-used solar + grid import), inner = solar production (self-used solar + fed to grid); self-used-solar is the shared segment drawn the same color/start point in both. Falls back to the old single-ring view when no grid-export sensor is available.
nodes.norm_label: fotovoltaico ring redesigned as two concentric rings with real totals

nodes.label: Energy config is optional when HA's own Energy dashboard is already configured
nodes.rationale: Ring reads the solar/grid sensor mapping straight from HA's Energy dashboard prefs when present, falling back to a device_class:energy guess otherwise; config.js's energy block only overrides either source, explicit values always win.
nodes.norm_label: energy config is optional when ha's own energy dashboard is already configured

nodes.label: Install-time self-check for panel_custom name:/folder mismatch
nodes.rationale: The single most common HACS/manual install mistake — name: not matching the deploy folder — previously produced a silent blank/black panel. Now prints a console.error and shows the same message on the page, naming the expected name: and the folder actually found.
nodes.norm_label: install-time self-check for panel_custom name:/folder mismatch

nodes.label: Shipped example config renamed to live_dashboard_config.example.js
nodes.rationale: The example previously shared the exact filename (live_dashboard_config.js) the user is meant to create, so editing it in place inside the plugin's own folder worked until the next update overwrote it.
nodes.norm_label: shipped example config renamed to live_dashboard_config.example.js

nodes.label: HACS custom-repository install support added
nodes.rationale: Installable/updatable through HACS as a custom repository, category Dashboard, alongside the pre-existing manual install method.

nodes.label: config.js can live at config/www/live_dashboard_config.js, outside HACS's managed folder
nodes.rationale: Previously config.js only lived next to panel.js, which a HACS update would wipe; the new location sits outside the folder HACS overwrites on update.
nodes.norm_label: config.js can live at config/www/live_dashboard_config.js, outside hacs's managed folder

nodes.label: Optional weatherStation config for local station sensors
nodes.rationale: Lets outdoor temp/humidity and the weather detail card prefer a local station over the weather: entity's current-conditions attributes, plus wind/rain/irradiance/ET0/feels-like/dew-point, none of which weather.* reliably exposes. Reuses irrigation.weather/et0 fields when already set.
nodes.norm_label: optional weatherstation config for local station sensors

nodes.label: discoverRooms() excludes any entity referenced anywhere in config.js from generic room lists
nodes.rationale: Found on a real installation: a weather station's sensors already driving irrigation math also cluttered its room card as a generic reading. One config-schema-agnostic exclusion instead of a hardcoded field list to keep in sync as modules grow.
nodes.norm_label: discoverrooms() excludes any entity referenced anywhere in config.js from generic room lists

nodes.label: loadScript() cache-bust propagated to every dynamically loaded script
nodes.rationale: The page's own ?v= only covered the iframe src, not discovery.js/config.js/i18n/backend files it loads in turn, so a browser could keep a stale discovery.js after a fresh deploy. Every loadScript() call now reuses the page's own ?v= so one ASSET_VERSION bump busts the whole chain.
nodes.norm_label: loadscript() cache-bust propagated to every dynamically loaded script

nodes.label: Optional config.appliances module for washer/dryer-style running-state UI
nodes.rationale: Explicit config since no HA domain standardizes it; a powerSwitch set on an appliance stops being auto-discovered as a plain toggle in its room to avoid showing twice.
nodes.norm_label: optional config.appliances module for washer/dryer-style running-state ui

nodes.label: [data-sel=true] selected-state CSS forced with !important over inline styles
nodes.rationale: A button's own inline style setting background/box-shadow/color always wins over a plain stylesheet rule regardless of specificity, making the active state completely inert (e.g. mobile mode buttons). Fixed with !important, and made the state a soft tinted background plus the existing inset-shadow/accent-color change.
nodes.norm_label: [data-sel=true] selected-state css forced with !important over inline styles

nodes.label: Empty-state guidance links to Settings->Areas when zero HA areas exist
nodes.rationale: The single most likely reason a fresh install would look broken on first load, since every room comes from HA's own area registry with no fallback grouping.
nodes.norm_label: empty-state guidance links to settings->areas when zero ha areas exist

nodes.label: Inline tooltip clarifies the ring's grid figure is import, not total consumption
nodes.rationale: Placed in the dashboard itself, not only the README, since someone who clones the repo may never open it.
nodes.norm_label: inline tooltip clarifies the ring's grid figure is import, not total consumption

nodes.label: Irrigation zones can run timed watering via input_button entities
nodes.rationale: Alternative to valve+durations for zones opened by a script/automation that already owns the timing, with no switch entity to drive directly; buttons takes over from valve when both are set.
nodes.norm_label: irrigation zones can run timed watering via input_button entities

nodes.label: panel.js derives its custom-element tag from its own deploy folder
nodes.rationale: Previously registered a hardcoded casa-panel tag regardless of deploy folder or name:, so any renamed folder or side-by-side second install loaded a blank/black panel with no console error. Now config/www/<folder>/panel.js registers <folder>-panel, so name: just has to match the folder, and two installs can run side by side without a customElements.define() collision.
nodes.norm_label: panel.js derives its custom-element tag from its own deploy folder

nodes.label: Cameras module: auto-discovered surveillance tab, snapshots, live MJPEG overlay, privacy mode
nodes.rationale: Sorveglianza tab appears from 2+ cameras; motion read from any binary_sensor with device_class:motion on the same device as the camera; Fotovoltaico card compacts itself when cameras are present to keep the fixed no-scroll layout.
nodes.norm_label: cameras module: auto-discovered surveillance tab, snapshots, live mjpeg overlay, privacy mode

nodes.label: First public release: auto-discovery, optional modules, demo mode, i18n
nodes.rationale: Auto-discovery of rooms/people/weather/alarm/quick-actions from HA's area/device/entity registries; optional modules hidden until configured; demo mode with an invented dataset opening from file:// or ?demo; panel_custom is the only supported install method in this release.
nodes.norm_label: first public release: auto-discovery, optional modules, demo mode, i18n
